cards.d: An accountant is a person whose job is to keep financial accounts.
cards.e: The accountant helped me keep track of my money.

cards.d: A capitalist is a business person who invests in trade and industry for profit.
cards.e: The capitalist invested in a factory that made wheat into cereal.

cards.d: Contempt is the feeling of having no respect for something.
cards.e: The judge had contempt for the wicked criminal.

cards.d: To dedicate oneself to something means to put a lot of time and effort into it.
cards.e: The nun dedicated herself to helping people in need.

cards.d: A ditch is a narrow hole cut into the ground by a road or a field.
cards.e: When the car slid off of the road, it fell into the ditch.

cards.d: An enterprise is a company or business.
cards.e: My father owns an advertising enterprise.

cards.d: When something is exquisite, it is very beautiful or pleasant.
cards.e: The artist made exquisite watercolor paintings.

cards.d: To finance someone or something means to provide money for them.
cards.e: The government financed the scientist’s experiments with new weapons.

cards.d: When someone is indifferent toward something, they have a lack of interest in it.
cards.e: Lisa is indifferent toward school. She doesn’t care what her final grades are.

cards.d: To irrigate means to supply water to land so that crops can grow.
cards.e: In dry climates, it is important to irrigate fields of crops.

cards.d: To maximize something is to make it as great in amount, size, or importance.
cards.e: You should exercise regularly to maximize a healthy lifestyle.

cards.d: When something is monetary, it relates to money.
cards.e: A strong monetary policy is important for a country to be successful.

cards.d: A precaution is an action that is meant to stop something bad from happening.
cards.e: As a precaution, you should put on a heavy coat before going out in cold weather.

cards.d: Preliminary describes something that happens before a more important event.
cards.e: The runners must do well in the preliminary races to qualify for the final race.

cards.d: To saturate something means to completely soak it with a liquid.
cards.e: The sponge was saturated with soapy water and dripped all over the floor.

cards.d: The simplicity of something is the fact that it is easy to do or understand.
cards.e: We were able to find the house thanks to the simplicity of the directions.

cards.d: To sow seeds means to plant them in the ground.
cards.e: He always sows his garden seeds in the springtime.

cards.d: Soy is a food made from soybeans, such as flour or butter.
cards.e: Soy can be made into tofu, sauce, and also milk.

cards.d: A spade is a tool used for digging.
cards.e: The gardener used her spade to make a hole for the seed.

cards.d: When something is upcoming, that means it will happen in the near future.
cards.e: The kids were worried about their upcoming exam.
